after.zh: 采 M 个点，只能分辨 M/2 以下的频率（奈奎斯特频率）。更快的波不会消失，而是折回来，冒充成一道慢波（k 冒充成 M − k），这就是混叠，采完以后无法再分开。所以要在采样之前把高于 M/2 的频率去掉，也就是先低通、再采样。
after.en: With M samples you can only tell apart frequencies below M/2 (the Nyquist frequency). Faster waves do not vanish: they fold back and pose as a slower wave (k poses as M − k). This is aliasing, and once sampled the two can no longer be separated. So frequencies above M/2 must be removed before sampling: low-pass first, then sample.

t.zh: 相机拍照、扫描仪扫图，都是把连续变化的景物变成一格格的数。这叫采样：只在一些位置记下值，用这些值代表整条曲线。
t.en: A camera taking a photo and a scanner scanning a page both turn a continuously varying scene into a grid of numbers. This is called sampling: recording values at only some positions and letting them stand for the whole curve.

t.zh: 采样会出怪事。视频里飞转的车轮有时像在倒着转；用手机拍电脑屏幕，屏幕上会浮出一圈圈原来没有的波纹。这些花纹是从哪来的？
t.en: Sampling can do strange things. A fast-spinning wheel in a video sometimes seems to turn backwards; photograph a computer screen with your phone and rippling patterns appear that were never there. Where do these patterns come from?

t.zh: 机关台上画着一条真实的波、采到的点，以及只看这些点时它像什么。三个小实验各问一件事：一道波能被别的波冒充吗？最少几个点才认得出它？采之前能做什么？
t.en: The bench draws a real wave, the samples taken from it, and what it looks like if you only see those samples. Three small experiments each ask one thing: can one wave pose as another? How few samples can you get away with and still recognise it? What can you do before sampling?

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：完成三个实验，每个只有一个可调的量。每次都比一比：从点上看起来的样子，和真实的波差在哪里。
t.en: In this level: complete the three experiments, each with just one thing to adjust. Each time, compare what the samples suggest with the real wave, and see where they differ.

brief.zh: 把一条连续的波变成一排点，只保留采到的值。三个小实验，看看采样会把什么弄丢、又会凭空造出什么。
brief.en: Turn a continuous wave into a row of points, keeping only the sampled values. Three small experiments show what sampling loses, and what it makes up out of nothing.

hint.zh: 点之间发生了什么，采样后谁也不知道。一个周期里至少要有几个点，才认得出这道波？
hint.en: Once sampled, nobody knows what happened between the points. How many points per cycle, at least, does it take to recognise the wave?

note.zh: 只采 16 个点。空心圈是 k = 3 的波采到的值。找一个别的频率，采到的点和它一模一样。
note.en: Only 16 samples. The hollow rings are the values sampled from the k = 3 wave. Find another frequency whose samples are exactly the same.

note.zh: 一道 k = 5 的波。减少采样点数，直到从点上再也看不出原来的波。能看对的最少是几个点？
note.en: A k = 5 wave. Reduce the number of samples until the points no longer show the original wave. What is the fewest that still reads it correctly?

note.zh: 这条线由四道波组成，要采 16 个点。采之前先把太快的波滤掉：保留哪些频率，采出来才和「应有的样子」一致？
note.en: This line is made of four waves and will be sampled at 16 points. Filter out the waves that are too fast before sampling: which frequencies should you keep so the samples match "how it should look"?
